senses.gloss:
औशन औशन or औशनस, अस्, ई, अम्,
originating from Uśanas, peculiar to him; (अस्, ई), m.
f. a patronymic from Uśanas; (अम्), n. (scil. शास्त्र)
the law-book of Uśanas; N. of an Upa-purāṇa; N.
of a Tīrtha.

औषण औषण, अम्, n. (fr. उषण), pun-
gency; black pepper.

औषदश्वि औषदश्वि, इस्, m. (fr. ओषदश्व),
a patronymic of Vasumat.

औषध औषध, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ओषधि),
consisting of herbs; (अम्), n. a herb, herbs collec-
tively; herbs used in medicine, a medicament, a drug,
a medicine in general; a vessel for herbs; a mineral.
—औषधावली (˚ध-आव्˚), f. a medical work com-
posed by Prāṇakṛṣṇa.

औषधि, इस् or ई, f. a herb, a plant, a medicinal
herb, an annual or deciduous plant, as grass &c.; a
plant in general, = ओषधि, q. v.; (ई), f., N. of a
goddess.
—औषधी-पति, इस्, m. an epithet of the
Soma, lord of the plants.

औषधी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to reduce to a medicament.

औषधीय, अस्, ई, अम्, medicinal, consisting of
herbs, herby.

औषर औषर or औषरक, अम्, n. (fr.
ऊषर), fossil salt; iron stone.

औषस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, sacred to Uṣas or the
dawn.
